symptoms_en: Young caterpillars feed on tender leaves; grown caterpillars bore round holes in the fruit and eat the inside with only part of the body thrust in.
symptoms_hi: छोटी इल्लियाँ कोमल पत्तियाँ खाती हैं; बड़ी इल्लियाँ फल में गोल छेद करके शरीर का आधा हिस्सा अंदर डालकर गूदा खाती हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
symptoms_en.quote: Young larvae feed on tender foliage Mature larvae bore circular holes Thrust only a part of its body into fruit and eat the inner content

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of bendi
symptoms_en.quote: Feed on the flowers Circular boreholes on fruits

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
management_en.quote: Collect and destroy the infected fruits and grown up larvae Grow simultaneously 40 days old American tall marigold and 25 days old tomato seedling at 1:16 rows Setup pheromone trap with Helilure at 12/ha

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Borer, Fall Armyworm, and Fruit Fly control: Spray Agniastra @ 3 litres / 100 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For caterpillars and other insects: Spray Dashparni Ark or Agniastra @ 7.5 litres + 250 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Collect and destroy infected fruits and big caterpillars. Grow tall marigold with the crop as a trap (1 marigold row for every 16 tomato rows). Set pheromone traps (12 per hectare).
management_hi: संक्रमित फल और बड़ी इल्लियाँ इकट्ठा करके नष्ट करें। फसल के साथ ऊँचा गेंदा जाल-फसल के रूप में लगाएँ (हर 16 टमाटर कतार पर 1 कतार)। फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएँ (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर)।
